description: This file defines FastAPI routes related to performing gap analysis between user competencies and target roles. It includes the implementation of an endpoint that computes competency gaps based on database queries and user input.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints.

classes.name: RoleCompetency
classes.description: Model representing the relationship between roles and competencies.

classes.name: GapAnalysisRequest
classes.description: Schema for the gap analysis request payload.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResult
classes.description: Schema for the result of a gap analysis.

classes.name: GapItem
classes.description: Schema representing a single gap item in the analysis.

methods.name: Dict[int,int] _levels_to_map(items: List[CompetencyLevel])
methods.description: Converts a list of CompetencyLevel objects to a dictionary mapping competency IDs to levels.

methods.name: GapAnalysisResult perform_gap_analysis( payload: GapAnalysisRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint that performs a gap analysis between current competencies and target role requirements.

ctags.name: perform_gap_analysis
ctags.signature: ( payload: GapAnalysisRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
